about: Bags of cells in standard base64, each with TON's own verdict on its bytes: ton is true where ton-blockchain/ton's std_boc_deserialize (crypto/vm/boc.cpp, creating each cell as crypto/vm/cells/DataCell.cpp's CellChecker does) reads one root of level 0, and false where it refuses them. The verdicts were taken by running TON's C++ as @ton/sandbox 0.45.0's transaction emulator (ton-blockchain/ton 8e6f0917), whose boc_b64_to_cell deserializes each bag, offline. The bags cover each field of the header, the CRC-32C, the index and cache bits, a cell's references, padding and level mask, stored hashes and depths, pruned branches, library cells and Merkle proofs and updates at each length and reference count, exotic cells of other types, pruned branches of every level mask under too few and enough Merkle proofs, and depths 1,024 and 1,025. The depth 1,024 bag is past this pairing's own bound of depth 32, which TON's deserialization does not hold.
